title: a provided capability is unavailable once Layer.provide has returned: the environment is scoped to the provided computation
notes: specification/requirements.mdx, 'Scoping': 'Provided implementations MUST be scoped to the provided computation. Layer.provide(layer, body) MUST keep its environment active through body and the Promise returned by body, then revoke it.' The same top-level call succeeds INSIDE the scope on the line above, so this case pins the boundary rather than the absence of a provider — 05-context-rows/unsatisfied-top-level-requirement pins the never-provided case. Fail-closed: a capability that outlived its scope would be ambient authority.
